content.title: [WIP] Goodbye and Good luck
content.body:
[WIP] Dear Friend,

I’m sorry I can't be there in person to send you off onto your mission, but things are really dire and I'm needed elsewhere.

As you are aware, we do not have much more time before our world gets completely consumed by whatever this dimensional corruption is. We have yet to find a suitable world to move to, and quite frankly, we are running out of options.

We do not know much about the place you are about to travel to, but what we know is that this dimension seems to reside between other dimensions, potentially out of reach for this corruption.

I’m afraid that once you reach the other side, we will have to cut the connection between our and the new dimension, as we cannot allow this corruption to follow you through it. Don’t worry though, as we will provide schematics to create a device that will let you contact us once you finish your evaluation of this new place.

I hope you will have success on your mission and that we will soon see you again.

Best of luck,
Your friend
